tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: bla sgrub rtsa ba tshig bdun pa'i: phrin las pad+ma'i sdong po bzhugs: :

rtsa gsum yongs rdzogs lha la 'dud: bla ma'i sgrub thabs ji snyed pa'i: rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig bdun las: spros te rnam pa tha dad pa'i: gu ru'i ting 'dzin lam khyer phyir: spyi ru 'jug pa'i phrin las ni: sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyis bstan: sa ma ya: thog mar rten dang yo byad bsham: skyabs sems tshogs gsag rgyud sbyang bya: na mo: rigs kun khyab bdag bde ba che: dkon mchog rtsa ba gsum gyi dngos: sku lnga yongs rdzogs gu ru rjer: byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi: bdag gzhan gnyis su 'dzin pa'i blos: sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i 'gro ba rnams: bde chen sangs rgyas sar 'god phyir: zab lam bla ma bsgrub par bgyi: khyab bdag gu ru sku gsum lha: chos dbyings rang byung klong nas gshegs: ye shes lhun rdzogs ngang du bzhugs: 'du 'bral med pa'i phyag gis 'dud: 'od gsal ye shes rol mos mchod: spang blang mnyam nyid chen por bshags: bral thob med la rjes yi rangs: dus gsum skye 'gag bral ba'i ngang: nges pa'i theg pas 'gro sgrol gsol: chos zad blo las 'das par bsngo: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐: snod bcud phyi yi maṇ+ḍa la: phung khams skye mched nang gi tshogs: gsang ba rang rig sku gsum zhing: 'bul lo bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs: oṃ gu ru rat+na maṇ+ḍa la pū dza me gha sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: bgegs bskrad srung ba'i 'khor los bcing: hūm̐: gdod nas 'gyur med rdo rje'i bka': nyon cig rtog 'khrul gdon bgegs rnams: rang bzhin med pa'i dbyings su dengs: 'das na rtog med khro bos gzhom: sarba bigh+nān a phaṭa: hūm̐: bde chen rol pa dbang gi zhing: snang stong zung 'jug rgyal ba'i sku: ye nas ye shes chen po'i mtshams: 'khor 'das gnyis med ngang du bcad: ma hā shūn+ya tā badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: bdag gnas yo byad byin gyis brlab: hrī: ngo bo ka dag dbyings chen nas: bla ma chos skus byin phob cig:

rang bzhin lhun grub zhing khams nas: bla ma longs skus byin phob cig: thugs rje gang 'dul pho brang nas: bla ma sprul skus byin phob cig: mkha' mnyam rgyal ba'i zhing bzhugs pa'i: bla ma rig 'dzin mkha' 'gror bcas: mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs: thugs dam gnyan po'i rgyud bskul na: ye shes thugs rje'i rtsal chen skyed: byin rlabs sprin phung thibs se thib: dngos grub char rgyun sha ra ra: phrin las glog 'od khyugs se khyug: sku gsung thugs kyi byin chen phob: rdo rje bzhi yi dbang mchog skur: snod bcud ye shes 'khor lor sgyur: thun mong mchog gi dngos grub stsol: dz+nyā na ā be sha ya a ā: oṃ āḥhūm̐: phyi mchod kun bzang rol pa'i rgyan: nang mchod 'dod yon nam mkha' mdzod: gsang mchod zung 'jug phyag rgya che: zag med bde chen sprin du gyur: oṃ badz+ra pū dza me gha sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: de rnams sngon 'gro'i rim pa'o: sa ma ya: dngos gzhi dam tshig bskyed pa ni: oṃ: chos nyid 'od gsal de bzhin nyid: ye nas ma bcos rdo rje sems: rang rtsal kun tu snang ba'i sprin: mkha' khyab snying rje nyi ltar gsal: zung 'jug rgyu yi sa bon ni: nam mkha'i dbyings su thigs par shar: ting 'dzin gsum gyis khog dbub la: gu ru so so'i mngon rtogs bsgom: ye shes rang gsal sku gsung thugs: rdo rje gsum du lhun gyis grub: rig rtsal dbang bskur gdod nas rdzogs: bde chen rigs lnga'i phyag rgyar bzhengs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: tshig bdun so so'i sham can gyis: ye shes sems dpa' dbyings nas bskul: sngags kyi 'od zer lcags kyu dang: badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ yis sdud: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa dbyer med bstim: hūm̐: rang rig rang gsal ye shes sems: dam tshig phyag rgyar brtan par bzhugs: sku gsung thugs kyi gzi byin skyed: g.yo med dgongs pas byin gyis rlobs: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan:

phyag mchod bstod pa'i phrin las ni: na mo: skye 'gag 'gyur med chos kyi sku: rang byung thugs rje longs spyod rdzogs: dngos grub char 'beb cir yang sprul: gu ru'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: na mo na mā mi: oṃ: mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen po ni: kun 'byung yid bzhin rin chen gter: nyer spyod 'dod yon sman raka gtor: sbyor sgrol mnyam nyid lta ba yis: gsang ba'i ye shes dgyes pa bskang: mchog thun gter gyi dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai bid+yā shab+da pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pra tīts+tsha swā hā: ma hā pañtsa a mrita rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā raṃ khā hi: sta na gha ṇa dharma dhā tu pū dza ho: hrī: ka dag gting gsal chos kyi sku: thugs mchog klong yangs chen por bstod: lhun grub dbyings snang longs spyod rdzogs: gsung mchog mkha' ltar khyab la bstod: mos pa dang mtshungs 'dul thabs ston: sku mchog cir yang sprul la bstod: bum bzang nor bu dpag bsam bzhin: yon tan re 'dod skong la bstod: 'khor ba dong sprugs phrin las kyis: 'gro kun dbyings su sgrol la bstod: gus pas bstod pa'i bsod nams kyis: bdag gzhan srid pa'i mtsho brgal te: ye shes bla ma'i sar 'khod nas: nyid dang dbyer med mdzad du gsol: dzap bskul bzlas pa'i 'phro 'du ni: hūm̐ hrī: ye shes 'khor lo bla ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dgyes pa'i skur bzhengs rdo rje'i dzap dbyangs sgrogs: 'od gsal dgongs pa'i rtsal skyed byin chen phob: 'khor 'das gzhi la rdzogs pa'i dngos grub stsol: thugs srog 'od lnga'i thig le'i klong: ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka ru: nyi zla kha sbyor sa bon mthar: sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las: 'od 'phros 'phags mchod 'gro don byas: tshur 'dus dngos grub rnam gnyis thob: snang stong sku la grags stong sngags: rig stong ye shes 'khor lor gyur:

'di ni bzlas dmigs spyi yi chings: bye brag ting 'dzin 'khrul 'khor bcas: so so'i 'dzab bsnyen grangs rtags sbyar: skabs su dbang dang dngos grub bskul: oṃ: sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes dbang bskur rmad po che: sgrub mchog lus ngag yid la stsol: dbyer med smin grol mdzad du gsol: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta dz+nyā na badz+ra sarba sid+dhi pha la ho: de rnams dngos gzhi'i las rim mo: sa ma ya: rjes su tshogs kyi mchod pa ni: dam tshig rdzas rnams tshogs par bsham: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: rtog sgrib bag chags bsregs gtor bkrus: tshogs rdzas zag med bdud rtsi'i mtsho: 'dod yon sprin phung mkha' khyab 'phro: dgyes skong dam tshig chen por gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrī: hrī: rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing khams mchog: pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang dang: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas zhing rnams nas: bla ma rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams: dgyes pas dgongs la gshegs su gsol: tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor byin gyis rlobs: bde chen nyams dang rtogs pa spor: 'ja' lus chos sku mngon gyur mdzod: badz+ra sa mā dza: dz+nyā na ā be sha ya a ā: oṃ: dbyings las rang byung rig pa'i rtsal: 'dod yon ma spangs ye shes rgyan: thams cad bdud rtsi chen por dag: bla med mchod pas mnyes gyur cig: ma hā pū dza a la la ho: ā: gnyis su 'dzin pas blang dor byas: ma rig dbang gis las ngan bsags: 'gal 'khrul nyams chag gang mchis pa: gnyis med klong du tshangs par stsol: badz+ra sa ma ya shud+dhe a: hūm̐: snang srid khro bo'i 'khor lor bzhengs: dngos 'dzin dgra bgegs bkug bstims bsgral: sha khrag ye shes bdud rtsi'i bcud: 'bar ba chen po'i zhal du bstab: sarba sha trūṃ bigh+nān mā ra ya kha kha khā hi: ho: rang lus bla ma rtsa thig rlung: yi dam mkha' 'gror lhun gyis grub: mnyam pa chen po'i dgongs spyod kyis: blang dor med pa'i dam rdzas rol: ga ṇa pū dza a la la ho:

a ho: thams cad bdag nyid bde ba cher: rnal 'byor rgyal po gar gyis rol: zung 'jug lhan cig skyes dga' mo: rdo rje gsang ba'i glu dbyangs len: te na hūm̐: te na te te hūm̐: hrī: don dam chos kun zung du 'jug: thabs shes brda yi phyag rgyas mtshon: rdo rje pad+ma rtags su sbyor: lhan skyes bde chen mthar phyin shog: e waṃ ma hā su kha ho: phyi nang gsang ba'i tshogs 'khor los: dam tshig skong zhing nye rgyur spyod: lhag ma'i bdud rtsis mar gnas brngan: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho: e ā ral+li hriṃ hriṃ dza: bh+yo: dam tshig rjes gcod mu ran skyong: lhag nyul pho nya dam can rnams: tshogs lhag 'dod rgu'i gter du bzhes: phrin las gang bcol myur du sgrubs: u ts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi: bla med bla ma'i dkyil 'khor du: 'dod yon zag med tshogs phul bas: thams cad rtogs grol dus mnyam ste: bde chen rdo rje'i sku 'grub shog: ces sogs thun min smon lam gdab: thugs dam bskul zhing gtor ma bskyang: hrī: ma bcos lhun grub bla ma'i sku gsung thugs: 'od gsal dbyings nas rol pa'i rtsal du bzhengs: bde chen gar gyis 'khor ba dong nas sprugs: gzhi rdzogs dag pa rab 'byams phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: dus bzhi mnyam pa nyid kyi ngang: sku gsum zhing du rgyud gsungs tshe: khas blangs rdo rje'i yal gam can: 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das pa'i: rgyud gsum srung ma bran 'khor bcas: tha tshig bzhin du gtor ma longs: dam bcas bzhin du phrin las sgrubs: gsang chen bstan pa rgyas par mdzod: sarba dharma pā la ba liṃ ta khā hi: sa ma ya karma ku ru ho: bh+yo: pad+ma'i bka' sdod bod khams skyong: brtan ma chen mo mched 'khor rnams: gtor ma bzhes la nad 'khrugs zlog: gangs can phan bdes bskyang bar mdzod: ma ma dhā ki nī ba liṃ ta khā hi: sa ma ya karma ku ru ho: gtor gzhong sbubs la dam sri mnan: hūm̐: rnam thar gsum gyi hom khung du:

dug gsum dgra bgegs gzir zhing mnan: rdo rje bro yi brtul zhugs ches: 'khor ba stongs bar rgyas gdab bo: s+t+wam+bha ya laṃ nan: mchod bstod bya zhing nongs pa bshags: bsdu ldang bsngo smon shis pa brjod: snod bcud dkyil 'khor rang la thim: de nyid dmigs med brjod bral klong: don dam thig le brdal ba che: slar yang dag pa'i 'khor lor shar: dge ba chos dbyings ka dag klong: 'gro kun rnam grol thob phyir bsngo: thams cad gdod ma'i sar phyin te: sku gsum bla ma myur 'grub shog: oṃ: stong gsal rig pa'i snying po can: bla ma chos sku'i bkra shis shog: sku dang zhing khams mkha' ltar khyab: bla ma longs sku'i bkra shis shog: gang 'dul phrin las rgyun chad med: bla ma sprul sku'i bkra shis shog: dge legs chen pos srid zhir khyab: dngos grub kun stsol bkra shis shog: me tog 'thor zhing rol mo bsgrag: shis pa'i dga' ston gong du spel: de dag rjes kyi bya ba 'o: sa ma ya: phrin las rim pa 'di nyid kyang: ma 'ongs rjes 'jug rnams kyi don: thugs kyi klong nas phyungs te bshad: skal ba ldan pa 'ga' zhig la: dus dang 'tsham pa'i 'gro don 'byung: de phyir zab mo'i gter rgyas thob: las can dag la bka' babs nas: gzhan phan gdul bya mtha' rgyas shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: :
